source.grade_2: Corrected serum calcium of <8.0 - 7.0 mg/dL; <2.0 - 1.75 mmol/L; Ionized calcium  <1.0 - 0.9 mmol/L; symptomatic
source.grade_3: Corrected serum calcium of <7.0 - 6.0 mg/dL; <1.75 - 1.5 mmol/L;  Ionized calcium  <0.9 - 0.8 mmol/L; hospitalization indicated
source.grade_4: Corrected serum calcium of  <6.0 mg/dL; <1.5 mmol/L;  Ionized calcium  <0.8 mmol/L; life-threatening consequences
source.comment: Split Corrected Calcium and Ionized Calcium into 2 separate terms. Conversion factor from mmol/L to mg/dL is 4.
